name: Persistent Rivers, Lakes & Watershed World System
design_rules: persistent water bodies retain base flow even without current rainfall
rain and temporary rivulets recharge permanent watersheds
lakes buffer short-term rainfall spikes through storage
groundwater memory prevents springs from switching off immediately after dry weather
North Woodland watersheds recharge more strongly than Ring Basin
permanent water remains traversable where depth and current allow
watershed rendering never uses emissive or glow feedback
